Set a tuned rule beside link's default on link's own segments

Source: R/compare_rules.R
knw_compare_rules.Rd

scripts/0298's comparison for any species and stage. Each rule goes through the three stages that make link's stored flags, on scratch copies of each group: the predicate gated by access (the habitat table's accessible and streams_access.access_<sp> > 0 together, the one gate knw_link_place(), knw_link_segments() and the grades use; the km the gate removes from the habitat table's accessible is reported as access_gate_differ_km), fresh::frs_habitat_overlay() with link's user-habitat rows for the species, and fresh's connectivity pass (.frs_run_connectivity() with link's default parameters), rearing and spawning together, because the connectivity pass reads spawning. Regenerated default is reported against the stored flags, never compared to them.

Usage

knw_compare_rules(
  connector,
  schema,
  species,
  stage,
  tuned,
  groups,
  link_dir,
  grades,
  visits = NULL,
  visit_species = NULL,
  scratch = "knw_compare_scratch",
  n_boot = 200L,
  seed_boot = 542L
)

Arguments

connector

a function returning a DBI connection.

schema

character(1) link persist schema.

species

character(1) species code.

stage

"rear" or "spawn": the stage the tuned rule changes.

tuned

one row of the scored grid (the recommended rule).

groups

character watershed groups to compare.

link_dir

character(1) a directory holding link's configs/default files at the run's commit: parameters_habitat_thresholds.csv, rules.yaml, parameters_fresh.csv, overrides/user_habitat_classification.csv.

grades

the species × stage grade table knw_grade_species() wrote (id_segment, watershed_group_code, size, dist_m, grade, grade_class), for the MAD with parent fallback, the exception distance and the graded km.

visits, visit_species

the build's visits_link and visits_species tables, for the FDIS detection check (NULL to skip).

scratch

character(1) the scratch schema (dropped at the end).

n_boot, seed_boot

the bcfishobs lift's bootstrap.

Value

A list of tibbles: compare (per group and total: km by rule, graded km, km by grade class, gained and lost), change (km gained and lost by reason and stream order), checks (FDIS detection on each rule's segments and the bcfishobs lift), segments (the per-segment flags under each rule, for maps), and log lines.

Details

default's predicate is fresh::frs_habitat_predicates() on link's configs/default. A tuned rule is the same predicate with its gradient maximum and, under a width rule, its width floor substituted, and with the stream branch's size test replaced: a stream-branch segment (a stream edge in no river polygon, wetland of at least 1 ha or lake of at least 100 ha) is in when its gradient is inside the maximum and either the size test holds (width, or MAD at least the floor) or a river of the rule's exc_q lies within exc_d m downstream (dist_m, walked from the segment's downstream end by knw_grade_species()). The river, wetland and lake branches stay fresh's. When a tuned rule equals default the injected form must equal fresh's own predicate on every segment, which the call asserts.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
pg <- function() DBI::dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres(), bigint = "numeric")
cmp <- knw_compare_rules(pg, "fresh_default", "CH", "rear", pick, c("BULK", "MORR"),
                         link_dir, grades)
cmp$compare
} # }
